notes: Read the entire saved markdown conversion (115,823 characters), including references and all appendices, and checked relevant quotations against PDF text. The saved 44-page English manuscript contains no explicit data/code availability or on-request statement, no preregistration declaration, and no target-study data-repository URL; it supplies task instructions/prompts and aggregate supplementary figures/tables. forms/c673.json data_and_code.data_url and code_url are both empty. The explicit on-request statement was confirmed in the author-supplied PsyArXiv metadata for the byte-identical saved manuscript; this is the basis for status, not an inference from absent links. No public participant/output-level data, arm assignments, scored rows, or participant idea corpus were found. Therefore the public files cannot resolve the missing unique analyzed counts and cross-task exclusions, human-only arm means/SDs/SEs or confidence intervals, exact forward-flow summaries, or diversity measures from participant texts. The saved translation matches the public preprint byte for byte, and the publisher title/authors match; a full results-level comparison of the Chinese version and English translation was not undertaken. All repository work used unauthenticated urllib requests with User-Agent atlas-screening/0.1; PDFs remained in memory. No login, account, access request or CAPTCHA bypass was attempted. Broad DataCite author searches were refined rather than exhaustively screening all namesakes; targeted title/author/subject and first-author OSF checks found no additional c673 deposit. The OSF DOI in the paper's bibliography, 10.31234/osf.io/ey7u4_v2, is Lai et al.'s different paper (p. 36); it returned HTTP 200 and was excluded. No GitHub repository is named for this paper. The third-party pwr software citation (p. 35), normalized from typographic spacing/dashes to https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=pwr, returned HTTP 200 and is not the authors' study code.
